'''Besh gate''' was a battered [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], active during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign and in use by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Thanda clan]] for business transactions. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], a group of selected individuals infiltrated Besh gate, disguised as [[Courier/Legends|couriers]] for one of these transactions, and neutralized Thanda's clan representative, [[Atlee Thanda]], and his guards.

==Description==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Besh gate, a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Zygerria system/Legends|Zygerria system]] in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] region,<ref name="ET" /> was old and badly maintained.<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown" /> The miasma resulting from heavy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] activity and the neglect of the station itself emitted a powerful foul smell within the facility. Besh gate could be connected to some ships with the use of an umbilical.<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown" /> It was composed of twelve [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] gathered around the central section.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
During the Empire's reign, [[Brevis Taug]], a shipping magnate who was funding the construction of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] ships for the Zygerrian [[Thanda clan]], would transfer funds to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled company on [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]], which would then pass the funds on to Besh gate, where [[Atlee Thanda]]&mdash;a member of Thanda clan and an up-and-coming slaver&mdash;ultimately received them.<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown" />

{{RPGseed}}
Eventually, a group of individuals were assigned to infiltrate the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station, passing as [[Courier/Legends|couriers]] during one of these transactions and then neutralizing Atlee Thanda. The disguised group succeeded in reaching the facility aboard the ship ''[[Skinchanger]]'', noticing several other ships docked. After the ''Skinchanger'' was ordered to dock, the group made its move and infiltrated Thanda's ship, the ''Scourge'',&mdash;which was connected to Besh gate&mdash;using an umbilical which had at least two Zygerrian guards at its entrance. The group engaged Zygerrian guards under the command of Thanda's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]], [[Liskran Dulce]], and ultimately succeeded in neutralizing Thanda. Afterward, the individuals were hailed for their fine work, and the ''Scourge''{{'s}} databanks turned out to be a valuable source of information about the operations of several other Zygerrian clans.<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Besh gate space station was first mentioned in the [[2003]] mini-adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. Among the outcomes of the adventure in the station, players can choose to either kill or capture Atlee Thanda, winning more points with the latter option. The mini-adventure incorrectly places the Chorlian [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and therefore Besh gate, in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region,<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown" /> but this information has been [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] by [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;in which Besh gate was indirectly mentioned within the entry for Zygerria&mdash;and [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="ET" />
